response: Introducing Saved Views, available today for every customer on a paid plan. If you've ever rebuilt the same filters and sort order to check status, group tasks by owner, or track a sprint, Saved Views ends that repetition. Set up a list exactly how you want it, save it, and return to it anytime with one click. Each user can save up to 50 views, so you can keep dedicated setups for different projects, clients, or workflows without losing track of any of them. Better still, views can be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same filtered list instead of recreating it themselves or asking around for the right combination of filters. Whether you're managing sprints, tracking bugs, or reporting to stakeholders, Saved Views helps your whole team stay aligned on what matters most. It's a small change that saves real time every single day. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
